method: stratified by confidence margin; Wilson interval on the design's effective sample size
scope: This is the error rate of the whole map. If part of the map was predicted from other inputs, that part's rate can differ widely from it. On a PASTIS map with half its tiles read without the optical input by a probe trained on radar plus optical, that half's rate was 74.1% against 19.7% on the rest, while random samples of 300 estimated 46.9% on average. Read by a probe trained on radar alone, that half was still 28.3% wrong against 19.7% (exp88). Draw the sample with --condition to get each part's rate.

valid_interval.method: stratified by confidence margin; valid at every sample size: the betting interval for a stratified sample drawn without replacement (Waudby-Smith and Ramdas 2020; the interval grade gives), the strata labelled in full added exactly
